answer: Every identity must prove it owns a real bank account. The network sends two tiny deposits, like $0.04 and $0.17, and the agent reports both within 24 hours. Until then it shows as a violet tile on the risk board and cannot earn. One account equals one identity, repeated every 90 days to catch sold accounts. Banks cap one person at 3 to 5 accounts, so 1,000 fake identities need 200 to 300 real humans, or stolen accounts at $50 to $200 each - $50,000 to $200,000 - before banks freeze the whole vine of linked accounts. This dams the tide of cheap Sybils.
